subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The Digital Biodiversity Library (DBL) is directed by Dr. Zulema Guzman.
• Guzman oversaw an initiative to create an online database of rare botanical specimens and field research.
• The DBL digitized over 15,000 specimens, including endangered plant samples and historical field notes.
• The creation of the database didn't require rare specimens to be moved from their secure storage locations.
• Researchers worldwide now have access to these materials.
prompt: The student wants to explain an advantage of the DBL's database being digital. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Over 15,000 specimens related to botanical research are part of the DBL database.
choices.B: By offering online versions of rare specimens and field research, the DBL's database provides worldwide access to these materials without moving them from secure storage locations.
choices.C: Among the materials in the DBL's database are endangered plant samples and historical field notes.
choices.D: The DBL's director, Dr. Zulema Guzman, oversaw the creation of an online database of botanical specimens and field research.

explanation:
Choice B is the best answer. The sentence explains an advantage of the DBL's database being digital, noting that the database provides worldwide access to rare materials since they don't have to be moved from their secure storage locations.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect. The sentence notes the types of materials the DBL's database contains; it doesn't explain an advantage of the database being digital.
